algorithms.name: CrossOriginStorageManager/getFileHandle(hash, options)
algorithms.html: The getFileHandle(hash, options) method steps are:

steps.html: Let result be a new promise.
Let realm be this’s relevant Realm.
Let global be this’s relevant global object.
Let origin be this’s associated origin.
Let partition be this’s partition.
If the result of running check Cross-Origin Storage permission given global is false, then:
Queue a global task on the DOM manipulation task source given global to reject result with a "NotAllowedError" DOMException.
Return result.
Let validationFailure be the result of running validate a COS request given hash and options.
If <var>validationFailure</var> is not null:
Queue a global task on the DOM manipulation task source given global to reject result with validationFailure.
Return result.
Enqueue the following steps to the Cross-Origin Storage queue:
If options["create"] is true:
Run complete a create request given result, hash, options, global, and realm.
Otherwise:
Run complete a read request given result, hash, origin, partition, global, and realm.
Return result.

algorithms.name: validate a COS request
algorithms.html: To validate a COS request given a CrossOriginStorageGetFileHandleHash hash and a CrossOriginStorageGetFileHandleOptions options, return null or a TypeError:

steps.html: If hash["algorithm"] is not a hash algorithm name recognized by [WEBCRYPTO], or is an ASCII case-insensitive match for "SHA-1", return a new TypeError.
If hash["value"] does not match the regular expression /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/ when hash["algorithm"] is an ASCII case-insensitive match for "SHA-256", return a new TypeError.
If options["origins"] exists and is not "*":
Let candidates be options["origins"], with a single string treated as a list of one.
If candidates’s size is greater than the user agent’s maximum origins list length, return a new TypeError.
For each candidate of candidates:
Let url be the result of running the basic URL parser on candidate.
If url is failure, return a new TypeError.
If url’s scheme is neither "http" nor "https", or if url’s origin is not a potentially trustworthy origin, return a new TypeError.
Return null.

algorithms.name: complete a read request
algorithms.html: To complete a read request given a promise result, a COS hash hash, an origin origin, a site partition, a global object global, and a Realm realm:

steps.html: Let entry be the COS entry in the COS registry whose hash equals hash, if any, or null otherwise.
Let disclosableEntry be the result of running apply availability gating given entry, origin, and partition.
If <var>disclosableEntry</var> is null:
Queue a global task on the DOM manipulation task source given global to reject result with a "NotFoundError" DOMException.
Return.
Let handle be the result of creating a new FileSystemFileHandle [FS] whose locator addresses disclosableEntry’s hash within the Cross-Origin Storage file system, in realm.
Set handle’s COS hash to disclosableEntry’s hash.
Set handle’s COS origin to origin.
Set handle’s may read to true.
Queue a global task on the DOM manipulation task source given global to resolve result with handle.

algorithms.name: determine COS disclosure
algorithms.html: To determine COS disclosure given a COS entry or null entry, an origin origin, and a site partition, return a COS entry or null:

steps.html: If entry is null, return null.
Let firstParty be true if the result of obtaining a site from origin is same site with partition, and false otherwise.
If entry’s storing origins contains a COS sharing record whose origin is same site with origin and whose partition is same site with partition, return entry.

If entry’s origins contains a COS sharing record whose origin is same site with origin, and either whose partition is same site with partition, or whose first-party and firstParty are both true, return entry.
If entry’s globally disclosable is true:
If entry’s hash is not on the PHL, return null.
If the user agent elects to apply GREASE’ing to this request, return null.
Return entry.
Return null.

algorithms.name: apply availability gating
algorithms.html: To apply availability gating given a COS entry or null entry, an origin origin, and a site partition, return a COS entry or null:

steps.html: If the result of running is an uncharged lookup given entry, origin, and partition is false, and the result of running charge a cross-site lookup given partition is false, return null.
Return the result of running determine COS disclosure given entry, origin, and partition.

algorithms.name: is an uncharged lookup
algorithms.html: To determine whether a lookup is uncharged given a COS entry or null entry, an origin origin, and a site partition:

steps.html: If entry is null, return false.
If entry’s storing origins contains a COS sharing record whose origin is same site with origin and whose partition is same site with partition, return true.
If entry’s origins contains a COS sharing record whose origin is same site with origin and whose partition is same site with partition, return true.
Return false.

algorithms.name: charge a cross-site lookup
algorithms.html: To charge a cross-site lookup given a site partition, return a boolean:

steps.html: Let budget be partition’s cross-site lookup budget.
Let now be the current time on a clock the user agent persists across sessions.
If budget’s window start is not null and now is at least the lookup window after it, set budget’s count to 0 and its window start to null.
If budget’s count is at least the user agent’s maximum cross-site lookups, return false.
If budget’s window start is null, set it to now.
Increment budget’s count by 1.
Return true.

algorithms.name: complete a create request
algorithms.html: To complete a create request given a promise result, a COS hash hash, a CrossOriginStorageGetFileHandleOptions options, a global object global, and a Realm realm:

steps.html: Let requestedOrigins be the result of running normalize requested origins given options["origins"].
If requestedOrigins is a list, set requestedOrigins to the result of running apply a COS scope ceiling given requestedOrigins and the result of running obtain the COS scope ceiling given global.
Let handle be the result of creating a new FileSystemFileHandle [FS] whose locator addresses hash within the Cross-Origin Storage file system, in realm.
Set handle’s COS hash to hash.
Set handle’s COS origin to global’s relevant settings object’s origin.
Set handle’s requested origins to requestedOrigins.
Set handle’s may read to false.
Queue a global task on the DOM manipulation task source given global to resolve result with handle.

algorithms.name: normalize requested origins
algorithms.html: To normalize requested origins given a (DOMString or sequence<DOMString>) or undefined origins, return "*", a list of origins, or null:

steps.html: If origins does not exist, return null.
If origins is "*", return "*".
Let list be « ».
For each candidate of origins (a single string is treated as a list of one):
Let candidateOrigin be the origin resulting from running the basic URL parser on candidate.
If list does not contain candidateOrigin, append candidateOrigin to list.
Return list.

algorithms.name: verify and store
algorithms.html: The verify and store steps, given the FileSystemFileHandle handle whose stream was closed, the complete written byte sequence bytes, and the closing operation’s relevant settings object settings, are:

steps.html: Let origin be settings’s origin.
Let partition be the COS partition of settings.
Let firstParty be true if settings is a first-party COS context, and false otherwise.
Let hash be handle’s COS hash.
Let computedValue be the lowercase hexadecimal digest of bytes, computed using the algorithm named by hash’s algorithm, per [WEBCRYPTO].
If computedValue is not exactly equal to hash’s value:
Reject the closing operation’s promise with a "DataError" DOMException.
Abort these steps.
Enqueue the following steps to the Cross-Origin Storage queue:
Let entry be the COS entry in the COS registry whose hash equals hash, if any, or null otherwise.

If the result of running check the COS storage limit given entry, origin, and bytes’s length is false, or the result of running charge a COS write given entry, origin, partition, and bytes’s length is false:
Queue a global task on the DOM manipulation task source given settings’s global object to reject the closing operation’s promise with a "QuotaExceededError" DOMException.
Abort these steps.
If <var>entry</var> is null:
Set entry to a new COS entry whose hash is hash, bytes is bytes, origins is an empty list, globally disclosable is false, and storing origins is an empty set.
Set the COS registry[hash] to entry.
Append a COS sharing record whose origin is origin, partition is partition, and first-party is firstParty to entry’s storing origins, if no equal record is already present.
Run upgrade resource visibility given entry, handle’s requested origins, partition, firstParty, and settings’s global object.
Set handle’s may read to true.

algorithms.name: store a fetched resource in Cross-Origin Storage
algorithms.html: To store a fetched resource in Cross-Origin Storage given a response response, a byte sequence bytes, a COS hash hash, "*", a list of strings, or null origins, and an environment settings object settings:

steps.html: If the result of running check Cross-Origin Storage permission given settings’s global object is false, return.
Let options be «[ "origins" → origins ]» if origins is not null, or «[ ]» otherwise.
If the result of running validate a COS request given hash and options is not null, return.
Let computedValue be the lowercase hexadecimal digest of bytes, computed using the algorithm named by hash’s algorithm, per [WEBCRYPTO].
If computedValue is not exactly equal to hash’s value, return.
Let requestedOrigins be the result of running normalize requested origins given options["origins"].
If requestedOrigins is a list:
Let internalResponse be response’s internal response if response is a filtered response, or response otherwise.
Set requestedOrigins to the result of running apply a COS scope ceiling given requestedOrigins and the result of running parse a COS scope ceiling given internalResponse’s header list.
Let origin be settings’s origin.
Let partition be the COS partition of settings.
Let firstParty be true if settings is a first-party COS context, and false otherwise.
Enqueue the following steps to the Cross-Origin Storage queue:
Let entry be the COS entry in the COS registry whose hash equals hash, if any, or null otherwise.

If the result of running check the COS storage limit given entry, origin, and bytes’s length is false, or the result of running charge a COS write given entry, origin, partition, and bytes’s length is false, abort these steps.
If <var>entry</var> is null:
Set entry to a new COS entry whose hash is hash, bytes is bytes, origins is an empty list, globally disclosable is false, and storing origins is an empty set.
Set the COS registry[hash] to entry.
Append a COS sharing record whose origin is origin, partition is partition, and first-party is firstParty to entry’s storing origins, if no equal record is already present.
Run upgrade resource visibility given entry, requestedOrigins, partition, firstParty, and settings’s global object.

algorithms.name: upgrade resource visibility
algorithms.html: To upgrade resource visibility given a COS entry entry, "*", a list of origins, or null requestedOrigins, a site partition, a boolean firstParty, and a global object global:

steps.html: If requestedOrigins is null, return.
If requestedOrigins is "*":

If entry’s hash is not on the PHL, the user agent is expected to log a console warning, or report an issue in its developer tools, saying that the entry is readable only by same-site origins and any origins on its origins list.
If entry’s globally disclosable is true, return.
If global has COS user activation, set entry’s globally disclosable to true.
Otherwise, append entry to partition’s pending global entries.
Return.
For each candidateOrigin of requestedOrigins:
Let record be a COS sharing record whose origin is candidateOrigin, partition is partition, and first-party is firstParty.
If entry’s origins contains a record equal to record, then continue.
If entry’s origins’s size equals the user agent’s maximum origins list length, then break.
Append record to entry’s origins.

algorithms.html: Whenever the user agent runs activation notification for a Window window [HTML], it must enqueue the following steps to the Cross-Origin Storage queue:

steps.html: Let partition be the COS partition of window’s relevant settings object.
For each entry of partition’s pending global entries, set entry’s globally disclosable to true.
Empty partition’s pending global entries.

algorithms.html: The serialization steps for a FileSystemFileHandle addressing the Cross-Origin Storage file system, given value and serialized, additionally:

steps.html: Set serialized.[[COSHash]] to value’s COS hash.
Set serialized.[[COSOrigin]] to value’s COS origin.
Set serialized.[[COSMayRead]] to value’s may read.

algorithms.html: The deserialization steps, given serialized, value and realm, additionally:

steps.html: If serialized.[[COSOrigin]] is not same origin with realm’s environment settings object’s origin, then throw a "DataCloneError" DOMException.
Set value’s COS hash to serialized.[[COSHash]].
Set value’s COS origin to serialized.[[COSOrigin]].
Set value’s may read to serialized.[[COSMayRead]].

algorithms.name: check the COS storage limit
algorithms.html: To check the COS storage limit given a COS entry or null entry, an origin origin, and a non-negative integer length, return a boolean:

steps.html: If entry is not null and its storing origins contains a COS sharing record whose origin is origin, return true.
Let held be the sum of the lengths of the bytes of every COS entry in the COS registry whose storing origins contains a COS sharing record whose origin is origin.
If held plus length exceeds origin’s storage limit, log a warning to the console and return false.
Return true.

algorithms.name: charge a COS write
algorithms.html: To charge a COS write given a COS entry or null entry, an origin origin, a site partition, and a non-negative integer length, return a boolean:

steps.html: If entry is not null and its storing origins contains a COS sharing record whose origin is origin and whose partition is partition, return true.
If one more write, or length more bytes, would exceed partition’s COS write limit for the current window, log a warning to the console and return false.
Charge one write and length bytes against partition’s COS write limit.
Return true.

algorithms.name: determine derived artifact reuse
algorithms.html: To determine derived artifact reuse given a derived artifact artifact, a site partition, and a list obtained of the COS hash values whose bytes the requesting context supplied from reads of the COS registry, return a boolean:

steps.html: If artifact’s producers contains a site that is same site with partition, return true.
If obtained does not contain every item of artifact’s sources, return false.
If artifact’s page-chosen inputs is empty, return true.
If the result of running charge a cross-site lookup given partition is true, return true.
Return false.

algorithms.name: check Cross-Origin Storage permission
algorithms.html: To check Cross-Origin Storage permission given a global object global, return a boolean:

steps.html: If global is a Window object, then:
Let document be global’s associated Document.
If document is null, return false.
If document is not allowed to use the "cross-origin-storage" policy-controlled feature, return false.
Return true.
If global is a DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope object, then:
Let owners be global’s owner set.
If owners is empty, return false.
For each owner of owners:
If owner is a Document and owner is not allowed to use the "cross-origin-storage" policy-controlled feature, return false.
If owner is a WorkerGlobalScope object and the result of running check Cross-Origin Storage permission given owner is false, return false.
Return true.
If global is a SharedWorkerGlobalScope object, then return true if "cross-origin-storage" is enabled in global’s permissions policy [WORKERS-PERMISSIONS-POLICY], and false otherwise.
Return false.

algorithms.name: parse a COS scope ceiling
algorithms.html: To parse a COS scope ceiling given a header list headers, return a set of origins:

steps.html: Let value be the result of get, decode, and split "Cross-Origin-Storage-Allow-Origin" from headers.
If value is null, return an empty set.
Let ceiling be an empty set.
For each token of value:
strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace from token.
If token is the empty string, continue.
Let url be the result of running the basic URL parser on token.
If url is failure, url’s scheme is neither "http" nor "https", or url’s origin is not a potentially trustworthy origin, return an empty set.
Append url’s origin to ceiling.
Return ceiling.

algorithms.name: obtain the COS scope ceiling
algorithms.html: To obtain the COS scope ceiling given a global object global, return a set of origins:

steps.html: If global is a Window object, then:
Let document be global’s associated Document.
If document is null, return an empty set.
Return document’s COS scope ceiling.
If global is a WorkerGlobalScope object, return global’s COS scope ceiling.
Return an empty set.

algorithms.name: apply a COS scope ceiling
algorithms.html: To apply a COS scope ceiling given a list of origins requestedOrigins and a set of origins ceiling, return a list of origins or null:

steps.html: Remove from requestedOrigins each origin that ceiling does not contain.
If requestedOrigins is empty, return null.
Return requestedOrigins.
